entities.summary: Zlatoust is a city in Chelyabinsk Oblast, Russia, located on the Ay River, 160 kilometers (99 mi) west of Chelyabinsk. Population: 174,962 (2010 census); 194,551 (2002 census); 207,794 (1989 Soviet census).
